title: Nitrifying consortium Metagenome
description: The aim of this study was to evaluate the nitrification behavior of a nitrifying consortium exposed to a binary mixture of phenol and m-cresol. The microbial community of nitrifying consortium in absences of m-cresol was characterized by pyrosequencing, in order to identify its taxonomical structure as well as a partial characterization of the genetic pool harbored by the members of the corsortium.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from Nitrosomonas europaea
